propositions: Existing stores lack .bridge_state/projects.json and bridge_project fields on tickets, causing tickets to resolve as absent-project with no recorded legacy default after upgrade
Migration must seed the project mapping as ensure units in the idempotent registry without writing ticket events, preserving the zero-commit property when converged

The seed unit writes .bridge_state/projects.json with legacy_default and a single projects entry from Backend.project only if absent; the compat-stamp unit conditionally adds multi-project-bridge to required_capabilities when mapping holds more than one project
Ensure units run at init, re-init, fsck --repair, and MCP boot, allowing client stores to converge with no operator action
The sweep must write zero ticket events, remain idempotent across multiple runs, and leave the tickets-branch tip SHA unchanged when already converged
New ids must be registered in REGISTRY_IDS, mapped in _registry(), added to test_ensures.py frozen literal, and documented in docs/migrations.md
